error.name: element_not_found

solutions.solution: Verify locator matches visible text or role
Wait for network idle or specific state

error.example:
# BAD - Element may not be ready element = page.locator(".button") assert element.is_visible()
# GOOD - Auto-waits for element from playwright.sync_api import expect expect(page.get_by_role("button")).to_be_visible()

error.name: flaky_test
error.description: Test passes sometimes, fails other times

solutions.solution: Use proper assertions instead of waits
Increase timeout for known slow operations
Check element actually exists in DOM

strategy.name: trace_viewer
strategy.description: Use Playwright Trace Viewer for debugging

steps.step: Review timeline, screenshots, and network logs

strategy.name: screenshot_on_failure
console_logging

pattern.name: retry_logic
pattern.example:
from playwright.sync_api import expect
def test_with_retry(page: Page): # Playwright has built-in retry with test.configure expect(page.get_by_text("Data")).to_be_visible()
